question: What’s the nearest hotel on the way from Aquarium Depot, Miami, FL toward Historic Stranahan House Museum, Fort Lauderdale, FL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.386248 25.685662)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.137447 26.118436)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.386248 25.685662)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.386248 25.685662)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: Historic Stranahan House Museum, Fort Lauderdale, FL
